text:
rosa-sales: Quick sync re: Kronos Labs POC. They want us to validate performance for chat-inference on their Dedicated/VPC setup. Asks: sustained 180 qps, ability to absorb 30s microbursts to 1200 qps, typical payload ~900 tokens, target p95 < 350ms, want CMK/HSM proof and a short security blurb for procurement. Also they'll ask for a two-week pilot price.

sam-eng: I can lead the run. Confirmed model: they requested a 13B-class quantized variant (4-bit + kernel tuning). Infra note: us-west private Dedicated cluster is fine. We'll need a burst pool and autoscaler settings for the 1.2k qps bursts.

tina-ml: For 900-token requests the working set is sizeable; recommend enabling prefix caching (256k window) and 64-token batching target to hit efficiency. Estimated steady-state GPUs: 3-5 depending on batching and KV hits. Burst headroom -> reserve 3 extra GPUs or rely on short-lived preemptible slots. I'll prep a quant-tune profile and a cached-run recipe.

sam-eng: Proposed execution plan:
- Smoke (10m): 1000 sequential requests via single-worker harness to sanity-check outputs and token accounting.
- Ramp (30m): linear ramp 0 -> 180 qps, verify warmup behavior, measure p50/p95/p99.
- Soak (1h): sustain 180 qps with real sample set from Kronos (anonymized) for realistic token distribution. Collect full telemetry.
- Microburst (3x 30s): spike to 1200 qps, observe tail, queuing, and loss.
- Resilience (chaos): simulate node drain to validate N-1 fallback; confirm rolling restarts do not breach SLA.

sam-eng: Quick run snippet for the harness (we'll use redwood-load):
```bash
# redwood-load example (local conductor)
redwood-load --api-key "\$POC_KEY" --model kronos-13b-q --concurrency 200 \
  --avg-tokens 900 --duration 3600 --report-interval 10 \
  --payload-file ./kronos_samples.json
```

alex-sec: For their security packet I need: CMK ARN (they can bring), whether we support HSM attestation for Dedicated, KMS usage pattern (envelope encryption flow), log retention defaults, and confirmation that we can redact inputs at rest. I'll draft a 1-page "KMS + logs" note. For FedRAMP-lite they may ask about key rotation and separation of duties, include that.

rosa-sales: Pricing ask: Kronos wants a two-week pilot rate and a run-rate estimate. Can we give a pilot price + estimated monthly committed price?

sam-eng: Ballpark pilot: 2 weeks of Dedicated + burst pool + 24/7 support ~ $6k-$9k. Committed monthly (steady 180 qps with redundancy) ~ $9k-$15k/mo depending on reserved GPU discount and region. I'll return with a refined table after the soak.

perf-bot: internal-bench: 2025-10-12 03:05Z - synthetic bench (900 tokens) on rtx-a10x cluster with prefix caching enabled:
- 180 qps sustained: p50=110ms, p95=320ms, p99=560ms
- 600 qps (synthetic): p50=220ms, p95=640ms, p99=1100ms
Notes: enabling KV cache retention and tweaking kv-shard sizes reduced p99 by ~30% in previous runs. Actual Kronos samples may shift numbers.

tina-ml: Good to know. Sam: please get a 500-sample anonymized payload from Kronos and an API test key. Also ask if they require HSM attestation or if CMK ARN is sufficient for the pilot.

sam-eng: Message sent to Kronos contact asking for samples, CMK ARN, and preferred pilot dates.

rosa-sales: Next actions / owners:
- sam-eng: schedule and run Smoke + Ramp this week, post raw metrics.
- tina-ml: prepare quant-tune profile and caching knobs; join soak run.
- alex-sec: draft KMS/HSM blurb and logs redaction note for procurement.
- rosa-sales: confirm pilot dates and send contract guidance.

rosa-sales: Thanks all 44d I'll update Kronos and loop in their security lead. :eyes:
